Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS FOR SUPPLY, INSTALLATION AND COMMISSIONING OF COVER SHED FOR TRAINEES 1. Execute excavation required for fixing/installation of the structure, cement, masonry as required. All col umns to be covered with brick masonry to give adequate strength. 2. Providing and fixing CGI Sheets, Fiber/Acrylic sheets, adequate painting to prevent rust etc. as required for construction of shed. 3. Providing suitable connection/approach to the existing path as required. 4. Providing installation of electrical wiring, suitable lighting and switches as required. 5. Site clearance i.e., excavation and removal of debris, discarding of the packaging materials, etc. Ensure the site is fully cleaned, cleared and ready to use before final billing. 6. Warranty of above-mentioned work for one year. The structure to be 100% relocatable within one year. 7. Site visit address: The work is to be executed at INI CME , Dapodi, Pune - 411031. The bidder shall visit the site before submitting the bid and assess the actual site conditions, dimensions, quantities, accessibilit

y and other requirements. 8. Site visit is mandatory, site visit certificate will be issued by the buyer. Site visit certificate should be upl oaded with bid document.
